svg.title: Take the long way — animated pelican cycling
svg.desc: An independently handwritten animated SVG: a pelican cycles a green touring bicycle along the coast. Webbed feet follow opposing pedals, knees bend with a two-link leg calculation, wheels rotate twice per crank revolution, a scarf flutters and the coastal path passes beneath the bicycle. Self-contained SMIL animation; no script, bitmap or external resource.

g.text: FOLLOW THE SHORE. FORGET THE CLOCK.
